name: Shuhang Chen
tagline: I work mainly in Unity and C#. LOCKDOWN and Last Mile are solo projects, Nancy did the art for Trail Adventure, and Sniff & Snitch is a team capstone.
bio: LOCKDOWN comes from my family's lockdown in Shanghai in 2022, and Trail Adventure from the hikes I took with a camera after moving to the US. Last Mile started with the delivery riders I watched in China in summer 2026 and the delivery robots on the sidewalks in Jersey City.
This site is built on RhineLabUI, an open-source Three.js project by LBEILC. I added the game cases, the console and the figure that carries the disc.
